---
description: "Maintain exec-ctrl evidence and policy records honestly."
applyTo: "docs/**,templates/**,examples/**,modules/**,framework/**"
---

Follow the v2 contract in [START_HERE.md](../../START_HERE.md).
Keep claims tied to actual evidence and relevant subject revisions. Do not turn
planned checks, stale reports, missing policy or deployed-but-unobserved changes
into passes. Preserve historical records and label version boundaries clearly.
Update generic guidance, reusable surfaces and then local evidence. Reuse existing
records; create additional documents only when they serve the task.
